meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed actual AiClient and SecretService changes against agent instructions and role tools: OpenRouter free is optional; the shared deadline and no cross-provider tool replay guard stay enforced.

auth.review_note: Reviewed the backend skill changes and capability boundary against unchanged account/login authorization: anonymous cart/status handles cannot read accounts, saved addresses or private owner records; browser credentials do not authorize remote tools.

commerce.review_note: Cross-reviewed current-price cart paise precision, captured-INR predicate, shared idempotent VerifiedOrderService, actual-discount GST and frozen tax evidence. Order/checkout docs distinguish captured payment from saved order and preserve later browser-cart edits on retry.

content.review_note: Reviewed the Docs skill provenance guidance against the unchanged BlogService and authored-content guide boundary. Static map references are discovery evidence only; publication visibility, Markdown storage, rendering and private-help exclusion remain the existing source contracts.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed current architecture, runtime guidance and source maps against an optional OpenRouter-compatible route. Existing PHP agents, remoteDB secrets and original provider fallback remain intact.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed Google reporting and tag setup alongside the Integrations field changes; no OAuth, tag, analytics or tracking credential/permission change was introduced.

http-errors.review_note: Cross-checked the explicit Stripe namespace fallback against the existing canonical client and checkout call sites. RequestFailureService registration, CLI failure handling and exact MCP/webhook session bypass remain unchanged. The regression captures the real bootstrap before any fixture preload.

interface.review_note: Cross-reviewed desktop and narrow Integrations UI, Google/compatible selection, masked router key, toggle and update semantics against existing Admin UI and responsive guidelines.

mail.review_note: Reviewed the existing mail and secrets dependency surface. The new model key stays inside encrypted app_secrets and does not change SMTP, email bodies, or credentials.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed the original scoped MCP client management guide and interfaces; a provider selection affects AiClient inference only, not local MCP grants or the public tool registry.

media.review_note: Checked provider and admin view changes against unchanged media upload authorization and media-library code. The OpenRouter field has no file upload or public asset effect.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed operator Help and its unchanged private role boundary against the new opt-in AI key control. No support, order, or admin tool permissions were expanded.

public-mcp.review_note: Compared the unchanged stateless MCP/discovery controllers and registered handlers with the public transport guide. Corrected map-only inheritance and related-view claims; source references do not imply browser-session inheritance, successful gateway autoload or a rendered JSON response. No protocol, capability or checkout behavior changed.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed public shopping tool transport and existing Support checkout. This change is an optional model route; no cart, checkout, payment or recovery behavior was altered.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed the sales-channel CLI references and catalogue guidance. This change only fixes generic PHP lint argument forwarding and failure propagation; feed, channel and catalogue operations are unchanged.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed added isolated MySQL/Playwright fixtures and main CI step; tests use synthetic-only credentials, no real provider calls or secrets and no privileged source checkout scripts.
